<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Geometric Sacred Mandala</title>
    <style>
        html, body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: transparent;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        canvas {
            display: block;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            outline: none;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="gl"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
        import * as THREE from 'https://esm.sh/three@0.168.0';
        import { EffectComposer } from 'https://esm.sh/three@0.168.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
        import { RenderPass } from 'https://esm.sh/three@0.168.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/RenderPass.js';
        import { UnrealBloomPass } from 'https://esm.sh/three@0.168.0/examples/jsm/postprocessing/UnrealBloomPass.js';

        // --- Configuration ---
        const CONFIG = {
            colors: [0x00ffff, 0xff00ff, 0xffff00, 0x00ff66],
            bloomStrength: 1.5,
            bloomRadius: 0.4,
            bloomThreshold: 0,
            rotationSpeed: 0.005
        };

        // --- Setup ---
        const canvas = document.getElementById('gl');
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        camera.position.z = 15;

        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ 
            canvas, 
            antialias: true, 
            alpha: true 
        });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio, 2));
        // Enhance colors for bloom
        renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ReinhardToneMapping;

        // --- Post Processing ---
        const renderScene = new RenderPass(scene, camera);
        
        const bloomPass = new UnrealBloomPass(
            new THREE.Vector2(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight),
            CONFIG.bloomStrength,
            CONFIG.bloomRadius,
            CONFIG.bloomThreshold
        );

        const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
        composer.addPass(renderScene);
        composer.addPass(bloomPass);

        // --- Geometry Factory ---
        const mandalaGroup = new THREE.Group();
        scene.add(mandalaGroup);

        // Helper to create glowing lines
        function createLineLoop(geometry, color, scale = 1) {
            const edges = new THREE.EdgesGeometry(geometry);
            const material = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({ color: color });
            const mesh = new THREE.LineSegments(edges, material);
            mesh.scale.set(scale, scale, scale);
            return mesh;
        }

        // Layer 1: Central Core (Icosahedron)
        const coreGeo = new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1, 0);
        const core = createLineLoop(coreGeo, CONFIG.colors[2], 1);
        mandalaGroup.add(core);

        // Layer 2: Rotating Star (Tetrahedrons)
        const starGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const tetGeo = new THREE.TetrahedronGeometry(2, 0);
        const tet1 = createLineLoop(tetGeo, CONFIG.colors[1]);
        const tet2 = createLineLoop(tetGeo, CONFIG.colors[0]);
        tet2.rotation.x = Math.PI;
        tet2.rotation.z = Math.PI / 4;
        starGroup.add(tet1, tet2);
        mandalaGroup.add(starGroup);

        // Layer 3: The Ring of Runes (Torus Knots)
        const ringGroup = new THREE.Group();
        const ringCount = 8;
        for (let i = 0; i < ringCount; i++) {
            const angle = (i / ringCount) * Math.PI * 2;
            const subGroup = new THREE.Group();
            
            // Small geometric markers
            const geo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(0.4, 0);
            const mesh = createLineLoop(geo, CONFIG.colors[0]);
            
            subGroup.position.set(Math.cos(angle) * 3.5, Math.sin(angle) * 3.5, 0);
            subGroup.add(mesh);
            ringGroup.add(subGroup);
        }
        mandalaGroup.add(ringGroup);

        // Layer 4: Outer Orbit (Torus)
        const torusGeo = new THREE.TorusGeometry(5, 0.05, 16, 100);
        const torusMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ 
            color: CONFIG.colors[3], 
            wireframe: true,
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.3
        });
        const outerRing = new THREE.Mesh(torusGeo, torusMat);
        mandalaGroup.add(outerRing);

        // Layer 5: Dashed Energy Field
        const dashedGeo = new THREE.RingGeometry(5.5, 5.6, 64);
        const dashedMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ 
            color: CONFIG.colors[1], 
            side: THREE.DoubleSide,
            transparent: true, 
            opacity: 0.5
        });
        const energyRing = new THREE.Mesh(dashedGeo, dashedMat);
        mandalaGroup.add(energyRing);

        // Layer 6: Particles
        const particlesGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
        const particleCount = 200;
        const posArray = new Float32Array(particleCount * 3);
        for(let i = 0; i < particleCount * 3; i++) {
            posArray[i] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 15;
        }
        particlesGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(posArray, 3));
        const particlesMat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
            size: 0.05,
            color: CONFIG.colors[0],
            transparent: true,
            opacity: 0.8,
            blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
        });
        const particles = new THREE.Points(particlesGeo, particlesMat);
        mandalaGroup.add(particles);

        // --- Interaction ---
        const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
        const targetRotation = new THREE.Vector2();

        window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            mouse.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
            mouse.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
        });

        window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            composer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        });

        // --- Animation Loop ---
        const clock = new THREE.Clock();

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            const time = clock.getElapsedTime();

            // 1. Rotate entire system slightly based on mouse
            targetRotation.x = mouse.y * 0.5;
            targetRotation.y = mouse.x * 0.5;
            
            mandalaGroup.rotation.x += (targetRotation.x - mandalaGroup.rotation.x) * 0.05;
            mandalaGroup.rotation.y += (targetRotation.y - mandalaGroup.rotation.y) * 0.05;

            // 2. Animate Core
            core.rotation.x = time * 0.5;
            core.rotation.y = time * 0.3;
            const pulse = 1 + Math.sin(time * 2) * 0.1;
            core.scale.set(pulse, pulse, pulse);

            // 3. Animate Star
            starGroup.rotation.z = -time * 0.2;
            
            // 4. Animate Ring of Runes
            ringGroup.rotation.z = time * 0.1;
            ringGroup.children.forEach((child, i) => {
                child.rotation.x = time * 2 + i;
                child.rotation.y = time * 2;
            });

            // 5. Outer Rings
            outerRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2 + Math.sin(time * 0.5) * 0.2;
            outerRing.rotation.y = time * 0.05;
            
            energyRing.rotation.z = time * 0.02;
            // Pulse opacity
            energyRing.material.opacity = 0.3 + Math.sin(time * 5) * 0.2;

            // 6. Particles
            particles.rotation.y = -time * 0.05;

            // Render
            composer.render();
        }

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
